note: People in the word hall (src/world/visitors.js). They stroll, sit and walk between the hall and its side rooms, keeping each room within its limits [fewest, most]. roles are what the player calls them (the look name is the role key in objects.json); each person says one line, voiced as its audio id by scripts/generate-voice.py.
